entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JSON complex collection with a property mapped to "key" breaks element ordering: OPENJSON index column resolved to the property #39438

Closed

  • dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent can generate invalid PostgreSQL SQL #39396
  • SelectMany fails when projecting an entity with an owned entity into an anonymous type #35862
    12.0-preview1
  • commandTimeout for some query only #18895
    12.0-preview1
  • Exception message for type mismatches #35846
  • Cosmos DB: DateTime serialization format causing errors in ordering and filtering #39113
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix JSON complex property projections with identity resolution #39442
    community-contribution
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Abstractions from 9.0.21 to 9.0.22 #39441
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.63.2 to 3.63.3 #39440
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 8.0.31 to 8.0.33 #39439
    area-infrastructure
  • Prototype bulk import API (DbSet.ImportFromAsync) (#27333) #39437
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39435
  • Get table alias out of subquery when owned entity projected with CROSS APPLY #39424
    community-contribution
  • Introduce scoped DatabaseFacade.UseCommandTimeout #39403
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Change DateTime JSON serialization to fixed width #39131
    breaking-change, community-contribution, api-review

Updated

  • Allow changing CLR type without SQL conversion #39397
    community-contribution
  • Report command failures while reading results #39405
    community-contribution
